description: This script generates license checksum list for Chromium project, utilizing Chromium's own license parsing tools to scan third-party directories and produce a formatted list of license files and their MD5 checksums for use in Yocto recipes.

methods.name: find_chromium_licenses
methods.description: Scans Chromium directories for license files, skipping known non-essential directories, and returns a set of license file paths used in the final build.

methods.name: print_license_list
methods.description: Generates a formatted list of license files and their MD5 checksums for use in Yocto recipes, based on the license files found in the Chromium source directory.
